decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells

T2-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles
response.rationale: The biopsy shows a CD20+ B-cell lymphoma phenotype with BCL6 and MUM-1, and CSF contains lymphoma cells, confirming primary CNS lymphoma. The extensive nonenhancing CNS lesions are consistent with PCNSL rather than demyelinating or viral etiologies.

rejected.why: MRI white matter changes are nonspecific, but positive CSF lymphoma cells and B-cell phenotype on biopsy exclude multiple sclerosis.
Diffuse T2 hyperintensities overlap, but the biopsy does not support PML and instead demonstrates clonal B-cell lymphoma, with lymphoma cells present in CSF.
